outgoingFlows.description: Infection through contact in households, schools, workplaces, and the general community
Progression from latent to infectious state after incubation period

parameters.name: R0
parameters.description: Basic reproduction number; moderate scenario R0=1.7, high scenario R0=2.0

parameters.name: Generation time
parameters.description: Mean generation time of influenza transmission

parameters.name: Clinical fraction
parameters.description: Proportion of infected individuals who become clinical cases (ill enough to seek medical care)

parameters.name: Household transmission fraction
parameters.description: Proportion of transmission occurring within the household

parameters.name: Community transmission fraction
parameters.description: Proportion of non-household transmission occurring in the general community

parameters.name: School and workplace transmission fraction
parameters.description: Proportion of non-household transmission occurring in schools and workplaces

parameters.name: School contact rate multiplier
parameters.description: Per-capita contact rates in schools assumed to be double that in workplaces

parameters.name: Vaccine efficacy (susceptibility reduction)
parameters.description: Reduction in susceptibility conferred by a matched pandemic vaccine

parameters.name: Vaccine efficacy (infectiousness reduction)
parameters.description: Reduction in infectiousness for vaccinated individuals who still get infected

parameters.name: Vaccine efficacy (clinical case reduction)
parameters.description: Reduction in probability of becoming a clinical case for vaccinated individuals who get infected

parameters.name: Pre-pandemic vaccine efficacy (susceptibility reduction)
parameters.description: Reduction in susceptibility conferred by a pre-prepared vaccine against the source avian virus

parameters.name: Vaccination rate
parameters.description: Rate at which population can be vaccinated per day

parameters.name: Vaccine protection delay
parameters.description: Time after vaccination for protection to develop

parameters.name: US population size
parameters.description: Assumed population size of the United States

parameters.name: GB population size
parameters.description: Assumed population size of Great Britain

parameters.name: Household quarantine compliance
parameters.description: Proportion of households assumed to comply with voluntary quarantine policy

parameters.name: Household quarantine external contact reduction
parameters.description: Reduction in external contact rates for quarantined households

parameters.name: Household quarantine internal contact increase
parameters.description: Increase (100%) in within-household contact rates during quarantine
